title: SnapshotComponent
description: One captured (or explicitly-not-captured) input/output belonging to a SnapshotManifest. See docs/SNAPSHOT_ARCHITECTURE.md for the REFERENCED_IMMUTABLE vs FROZEN_COPY classification rule this component's storageMode records.

sourcePath.description: Repo-relative path to the original (live/mutable or already-immutable) source this component was captured from. Null only when availabilityStatus is MISSING or NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_STAGE and no source path was ever consulted.

snapshotPath.description: Repo-relative path to the snapshot-owned frozen copy. Present only when storageMode is FROZEN_COPY; null for REFERENCED_IMMUTABLE (no duplicate bytes) and for MISSING/NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_STAGE components.

storageMode.description: REFERENCED_IMMUTABLE: sourcePath+contentHash is sufficient because the source is write-once-per-(date,key) by construction. FROZEN_COPY: the source is mutable/overwritten/upsertable, so the exact bytes/record used at capture time were copied into snapshotPath. Null when the component was never captured (availabilityStatus MISSING or NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_STAGE).

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact bytes referenced (REFERENCED_IMMUTABLE: the source file as it stood at capture time; FROZEN_COPY: the frozen copy, which must equal the source's hash at the moment of freezing).

capturedAt.description: When this specific component's underlying evidence was captured/observed (the 'asOf' timestamp) -- may differ from the manifest's own capturedAt.

producer.description: Script/module that produced sourcePath, e.g. 'scripts/build_market_ledger.py'. Copied verbatim from the source artifact's own metadata where one exists, never guessed.

limitationReason.description: Required whenever availabilityStatus is not AVAILABLE. Never null when the component is missing/partial -- an unexplained gap is a bug, not a valid state.
